radoyon_author_accession_hint: The host generates one when this is blank.
radoyon_author_all_normal: Nothing substituted — the learner will read a normal study.
radoyon_author_available_at_hint: Blank uses the order’s own turnaround.
radoyon_author_baseline_hint: The complete normal examination this case starts from.
radoyon_author_custom_ref_hint: A remote: path served by the host. Material referenced this way declares no geometry, so splice compatibility cannot be checked.
radoyon_author_empty: No imaging yet. Add a study to begin.
radoyon_author_intro: Start from a normal study, then say what is different about this patient.
radoyon_author_is_normal_short: Normal for this patient. A learner who orders it gets this study, complete.
radoyon_author_no_normal: Orderable, but the archive has no example of this study yet — a learner who orders it gets the catalogue’s written normal and no images.
radoyon_author_no_sources: No pathology material in the archive yet — derive some (scripts/make-lesion.mjs) or use an advanced reference.
radoyon_author_none_match: No study in the catalogue matches.
radoyon_author_release_hint: Withhold it to make them read the images first.
radoyon_author_release_report: Release the report to the learner
radoyon_author_same_order_hint: Show only the archive’s other examples of this same order.
radoyon_author_splice_warning: Spliced slices must match the baseline geometry, or measurements across the seam will be wrong.
radoyon_author_substitutions: What is different about this patient
radoyon_author_undo_removed_study: Study removed, with its findings and report.
radoyon_author_unlisted_hint: This case changes studies the catalogue no longer lists. They are still saved and still served — link each to an order, or remove it.
radoyon_baseline_abnormal: From the abnormal library — findings not read
radoyon_ctl_sigmoid_hint: Sigmoid rolls contrast off instead of clipping — it holds the apices and the abdomen on one film.
radoyon_host_catalogue_failed: The radiology catalogue could not be loaded, so no studies are listed. Reload the page or contact an administrator.
radoyon_inspect_no_loader: This host has not supplied an image loader, so the study cannot be opened here.
radoyon_inspect_nothing: There is no imaging for this study yet — a learner who orders it gets the catalogue’s written normal and no pictures.
radoyon_library_abnormal_note: A case may be abnormal from the outset, so an abnormal study is a legitimate baseline — but the usual move is a normal one with the finding spliced in.
radoyon_load_failed: This study could not be loaded.
radoyon_no_measurements: None yet — use the distance or region tool.
radoyon_report_evidence_hint: Attached automatically — what the room observed, not what the report claims.

radoyon_report_normal_label: Reference — a normal study of this type
radoyon_review_primary_long: An example is in place; nobody has read these images. What is claimed about them comes from the collection they were drawn from, not from the pixels.
